question: How can AI help me improve my trip?

sections.beforeHtml: Plantour AI can review an existing trip and suggest a better way to organize it. Sign in, open the Dashboard, and in the Artificial Intelligence section click AI trip improvements.
items: Open the page for the current trip and read the short scope summary near the top.
If you already have saved improvements, confirm replacement when Plantour asks you.
Wait while Plantour reviews the trip data available to you and creates a new ordered list of suggestions.
After generation, Plantour opens the trip improvements page automatically.
Read each suggestion in order. The list can show route, timing, packing, todo, budget, or general planning ideas.
Mark a suggestion as accepted or rejected when you decide what to do with it.
Use the page menu to expand or collapse the whole list when you want a quicker review.
sections.afterHtml: Admins get suggestions for personal and shared trip data. Participants get suggestions only for their own trip data. The AI never replaces your real trip data directly. It saves a list of proposed improvements for you to review first.
